+// CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) request and response headers.
+const (
+	corsHOrigin                        = "Origin"

+	corsHAllow                         = "Allow"
+	corsHAccessControlRequestMethod    = "Access-Control-Request-Method"
+	corsHAccessControlRequestHeaders   = "Access-Control-Request-Headers"
+	corsHAccessControlAllowOrigin      = "Access-Control-Allow-Origin"
+	corsHAccessControlAllowMethods     = "Access-Control-Allow-Methods"
+	corsHAccessControlAllowHeaders     = "Access-Control-Allow-Headers"
+	corsHAccessControlExposeHeaders    = "Access-Control-Expose-Headers"
+	corsHAccessControlMaxAge           = "Access-Control-Max-Age"
+	corsHAccessControlAllowCredentials = "Access-Control-Allow-Credentials"
+)
+
+// corsDefaultMethods answers a preflight request when no method can be
+// detected for its path.
+var corsDefaultMethods = []string{
+	http.MethodGet, http.MethodHead, http.MethodPost, http.MethodPut,
+	http.MethodPatch, http.MethodDelete, http.MethodOptions,
+}
+
+// CORSOptions configures the CORS middleware and Mux#EnableCORSWithOptions.
+type CORSOptions struct {
+	// AllowOrigin is the value of Access-Control-Allow-Origin. Use "*" to
+	// allow any origin (an empty value means the same), a single origin such
+	// as "https://example.com", or several origins separated by commas, in
+	// which case the request's Origin is echoed back when it is one of them.
+	AllowOrigin string
+
+	// AllowMethods is the list of methods sent in Access-Control-Allow-Methods
+	// to a preflight request. When empty, the methods that the requested
+	// resource answers to are detected from the router.
+	AllowMethods []string
+
+	// AllowHeaders is the list of request headers sent in
+	// Access-Control-Allow-Headers to a preflight request. When empty, the
+	// headers named by the request's Access-Control-Request-Headers are
+	// allowed.
+	AllowHeaders []string
+
+	// ExposeHeaders is the list of response headers that browsers may expose
+	// to the calling script, sent in Access-Control-Expose-Headers.
+	ExposeHeaders []string
+
+	// MaxAge is how long, in seconds, a browser may cache the answer to a
+	// preflight request. Zero or less leaves Access-Control-Max-Age out.
+	MaxAge int
+
+	// AllowCredentials sends Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true, which
+	// lets browsers include cookies and authorization headers.
+	AllowCredentials bool
+}
+
+// DefaultCORSOptions returns the options that Mux#EnableCORS uses: any origin,
+// the request headers most APIs need, and a preflight cache of one hour. The
+// allowed methods are left empty so that they are detected for each resource.
+func DefaultCORSOptions() CORSOptions {
+	return CORSOptions{
+		AllowOrigin: "*",
+		AllowHeaders: []string{
+			"Accept",
+			"Authorization",
+			"Content-Type",
+			"X-CSRF-Token",
+			"X-Requested-With",
+		},
+		MaxAge: 3600,
+	}
+}
+
+// CORS returns a middleware that adds the CORS headers set out in options to
+// every response and answers preflight requests (OPTIONS) with a 204 status
+// and the Access-Control-Allow-* headers, without calling the next handler.
+//
+// A preflight request is an OPTIONS request that carries an
+// Access-Control-Request-Method header, or one for a route that has no OPTIONS
+// handler of its own. Any other OPTIONS request is left to the route.
+func CORS(options CORSOptions) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
+	return newCORSPolicy(options).middleware
+}
+
+// corsPolicy is CORSOptions prepared for use on every request: the lists are
+// joined once, and later changes to the options' slices do not reach it.

+	allowMethods     []string
+	allowHeaders     string
+	exposeHeaders    string

+	allowCredentials bool
+}
